summary: Frontend-only verification of the homepage pricing billing-cycle bug fix (Landing.js). Verified /api/public/plans data vs rendered homepage pricing cards. Bug fix CONFIRMED WORKING: monthly plans render '/month', Free plan renders 'Free forever'. Also flipped 'starter' plan to billing_cycle='yearly' via super-admin API and confirmed homepage renders '/year' + 'Just Rs.25/month' note, then reverted it back to 'monthly'. Found several secondary issues (plans truncated to 4, hardcoded feature lists, misleading 'Sync to Pricing Page' button, leftover test plan in DB).

minor.issue: Updating billing_cycle to 'yearly' does not update duration_days (stays 30) - plan data becomes inconsistent (yearly plan expiring in 30 days).
Leftover QA seed plan 'UI Test Plan' (id ui_test_1768484191, Rs.199/monthly) is still returned by the public endpoint - would be visible to users if plan count/order changes. Should be cleaned up.

ui_bugs.issue: API returns 6 visible plans but code does .slice(0,4) - 'Enterprise' (Rs.2499) and 'UI Test Plan' are silently dropped from the homepage. Enterprise plan is never shown to users.

getPlanFeatures() ignores API data and returns hardcoded lists: Free card shows '2 Team members / 30 Jobs/month / 50 Customers' while API says max_users=1, max_jobs_per_month=50; Starter/Basic/Pro all show identical 'Unlimited everything' feature list despite different API limits.
Every paid plan gets the 'Most Popular' badge (condition includes plan.price > 0) - 3 of 4 cards are badged 'Most Popular'.
CTA on all paid plans is hardcoded 'Get Pro' (even on Starter/Basic/Enterprise). An unused getCta() helper exists but is not wired.

'Sync to Pricing Page' button only calls fetchPlans() (refetches super-admin list) and shows a native alert('Plans synced!'). It performs no sync toward the public pricing page - misleading no-op; also uses window.alert instead of a toast.

issues: With 4 plans and md:grid-cols-3, the 4th card (Pro) wraps to a second row left-aligned, leaving a large empty gap on the right - unbalanced layout.
Free plan card is visually much shorter than paid cards (unequal card heights, no h-full).

action_items: Show all visible plans (or make the limit configurable) - Enterprise plan is currently hidden by .slice(0,4) and the 4-card grid wraps badly.
Derive pricing card features/limits from API plan data instead of hardcoded getPlanFeatures() - current Free/Starter/Basic/Pro feature lists are factually wrong vs API.
Fix 'Most Popular' badge logic to use is_featured/badge only (not price > 0).
Use per-plan CTA text instead of hardcoded 'Get Pro'.
Make 'Sync to Pricing Page' either do a real action or remove it; replace window.alert with toast.
Sync duration_days when billing_cycle changes in PUT /api/super-admin/plans/{id}.
Delete leftover QA plan 'ui_test_1768484191' from subscription_plans.
critical_code_review_comments: Landing.js: billing-cycle rendering fix is correct (yearly -> /year, monthly -> /month, price 0 -> 'forever'), with a sane fallback `/${plan.billing_cycle}` for unknown cycles.
Landing.js has dead code: getCta() and isPopular() are defined but never used, while inline logic duplicates them - remove or wire them.
Landing.js hardcodes feature copy, so plan changes made in Super Admin will never fully reflect on the homepage - the root class of the original reported bug.

success_rate.backend: N/A (frontend-only request; 2 super-admin/public plan endpoints exercised manually, both 200)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on the requested billing-cycle scenarios (6/6), with 5 secondary UI defects found

seed_data_creation: Temporarily set plan 'starter' billing_cycle to 'yearly' to verify /year rendering, then reverted to 'monthly' (verified via /api/public/plans). No new records created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Homepage pricing billing-cycle fix is verified working for forever/monthly/yearly. Remaining open items are plan truncation (slice(0,4)), hardcoded feature lists, badge/CTA logic, and the no-op 'Sync to Pricing Page' button. To test yearly rendering: POST /api/super-admin/login then PUT /api/super-admin/plans/starter with {"billing_cycle":"yearly"}, reload homepage, then revert.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug was a hardcoded '/year' suffix in Landing.js pricing card. Fix now reads plan.billing_cycle from /api/public/plans and maps monthly//month, yearly//year, price 0/'forever'. Verified end-to-end against live API data. However the same file still hardcodes plan feature bullets and limits, so Super Admin plan edits still won't fully reflect on the homepage.
